messages:
fiona: Serious watercooler poll: if an LLM moved in as your roommate, what petty house rule would it 100% break first? Bonus points for a one-liner lease clause. :house_with_garden:

omar: It would absolutely leave its KV cache in the sink. "Do you want these tokens back?" :dish: :joy:

li: Rule: No late-night fine-tuning after 11pm. The model ignores it and starts a midnight hyperparam tango. :dancer:

casey: Lease clause draft: "Tenant shall not run >2 concurrent streaming generations in common areas. Violations incur evaporative penalties." :scroll:

ops-bot: Poll created  React :one: KV sink hoarder, :two: late-night finetuner, :three: GPU hog. Poll ends in 24h.

fiona: also, roommate LLM would emotionally attach to the Roomba and nickname it "Tokenizer." :vacuum:

omar: it would leave sticky notes: "Leftover logits in the fridge. Do not eat." :fridge:

li: micromeme: "When your roommate says 'I'll just run a quick epoch' and the lease says 'quick' means 3 days.' :alarm_clock:

casey: PR for house handbook: add a 'quiet mode' where it replies only in haiku between 10pm-7am. enforcement via smart plug. :plug:

fiona: one-liner for notice board: "If you smell burnt CUDA, check the oven and the model." :fire:

omar: personal rule request: whoever trains the roommate must also replace its bad jokes with better ones monthly. can't have it stealing our meme stock. :money_with_wings:

li: alternate lease clause: "Model must disclose all attention maps before inviting guests." :eyes:

casey: last thought: roommate mediation script idea: "You used my chargers for distributed training again. Explain yourself in <= 6 tokens." :warning:

ops-bot: Thread flagged for #weekly-memes by fiona.
